text_block_list.text:
One day, everyone scheduled to participate 
in the 'U.A.F.' was gathered in the gym—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Announcement! The time for this year's 
'Summer Training Camp' has finally 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure many of you already know, but the 
Summer Training Camp is a unique training 
regime where we stay overnight at the 
facilities!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Our trainees should be able to grow 
significantly from this opportunity as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Encouragement! Looking ahead to 'July' 
when the Summer Training Camp begins, I 
want all Trainers to get your Umamusume 
into peak condition!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp goes by in the blink of an 
eye! There's no time to be 'taking a 
break'!
choice_data_list:
(I need to make proper adjustments 
starting now...!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Attention! While training naturally comes 
first—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes you need a proper breather! 
Going on an "outing" to the beach or 
somewhere is a great way to refresh 
yourself—I highly recommend it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Please consult thoroughly with your 
trainees about that point as you proceed 
with the training camp!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Though it's a brief two-month span from 
July to August—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Do your utmost to ensure we have a 
fruitful summer training camp!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That's all! That covers the basic overview 
of the "Summer Training Camp" so far!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Beyond this point, we will be sharing 
important matters regarding the 'U.A.F.'! 
—Ms. Tsurugi, over here!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Announcement! The academy has secured 
permission to conduct 'U.A.F.' training at 
facilities near the training camp grounds!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Those who train for the "U.A.F." events 
during summer training camp should 
definitely make good use of this!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"The management staff has also prepared 
equipment for each event. We've set things 
up so you can train on the same scale as 
back at the academy."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, our management team has 
established communication lines to support 
you at any time during the training camp, 
so please don't hesitate to reach out.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
All of us on the U.A.F. management team 
also hope that your summer camp will be a 
fulfilling one. ...Please do your best.

—And so, we heard all about the "Summer 
Camp" from Chairwoman Akikawa!

It seems that thanks to the generosity of 
the "U.A.F." management, event training 
will be available even during the summer 
training camp...!

Let's keep a close eye on <chrname>'s condition and 
energy to prepare for the actual training 
camp...

It begins in the first half of July, two 
turns from now, so it would be best to 
start preparing right away.
